profile.headline: Software Engineer | Computer Science B.S. @ Johns Hopkins University

positions.title: Data Science Research Assistant
positions.description:
(Carsten Prasse Lab)
Cleaned and analyzed liquid chromatography - high-resolution mass spectrometry data from a training set of >1,000 chemicals used on farms and manure samples from seven farms across PA, MD, and VA
Utilized R to develop and optimize machine learning models for predicting concentrations of potentially harmful chemicals in manure samples from mass spectrometry peak areas and 1,444 chemical molecular descriptors
Received $6,000 in funding for independent research through Provost’s Undergraduate Research Award

company.name: Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health

positions.title: Student Desktop Specialist
positions.description:
Imaged and deployed Windows OS to laptops to be used by University Finance staff
Troubleshooted printer and deployment issues with senior team members
Maintained database of workstations distributed to Johns Hopkins University Finance employees
Securely wiped sensitive information from hard drives to be recycled

positions.title: Machine Learning Team Member
positions.description:
Collaborated with a team of 14 students to develop and optimize deep learning algorithms for simulating COVID-19 spread
in any given community
Investigated and implemented algorithms to cluster geolocation data into convenience zones
Exchanged results with students and professors at University of Tsukuba and Johns Hopkins University

honors.title: Provost’s Undergraduate Research Award
honors.issuer: Issued by Johns Hopkins University · Mar 2022
